assumptions: Sigma is exactly the inherited22working-unit alphabet. Each w is a nonempty retained complete group over Sigma.
C is one fixed finite inventory of K nonempty carrier strings over Sigma. Entire carrier occurrences align with the stipulated working-unit boundaries.
Every retained group contains at least one intact complete carrier from C; no claim of nucleus identity is inferred from this combinatorial premise.
argument: Select one working unit r(c) from each nonempty carrier c. Because c occurs inside a group only as complete working units, every group contains at least one of these selected units.

The distinct representative set R intersects every group and has cardinality at most K, regardless of shared codeforms, nonunique decoding, arbitrary code lengths or the placement of other source material.
Complementation identifies hitting sets with feasible fixed null-type sets: tau(W)=22-max_feasible_null_types. Thus K>=tau(W). Token-mass maxima are irrelevant to this cardinality proof.
proof.no_converse: Having at least tau carriers does not establish actual source nuclei, a phonology, historical code, complete spelling rule or source fit.

checked_primary_arithmetic.source: 1355 REPORT exact capacity table, last TYPE column; original validation inherited, not independently rerun here.
checked_primary_arithmetic.sensitivity: GE2 selects forms on at least two physical leaves; repeats do not add constraints to the set-cover proof. It is sensitivity, not holdout or correction of rare forms.

mandatory_cautions.case: Code boundary inside a working unit
mandatory_cautions.consequence: If a hypothesized carrier is an ASCII fragment or drawn component inside working ch/ckh/etc, selecting one22-alphabet unit from that carrier is undefined. If two source codes fuse across a working-unit boundary, a carrier may no longer survive intact. The present proof does not cover those representations.
mandatory_cautions.required_wording: Nonempty working-unit strings with unit-aligned intact occurrences, not arbitrary physical pen-stroke/ASCII substrings.

mandatory_cautions.consequence: The contract requires a nucleus carrier in every retained written group, not merely every spoken/prosodic word. Separately written clitics, abbreviations, nonlexical labels, consonant-only written forms or multi-group phonological words can break that premise. No regrouping or exception is inferred.

Nucleus categories must follow an independently fixed language-stage analysis including any independently syllabic consonants. Vowel letters, vowel qualities, phonemes, long/short distinctions, diphthong sequences and nucleus categories are not interchangeable counting units.

K counts distinct complete written carriers across all categories and contexts. If category j has at most a_j whole carrier variants, sum_j a_j>=tau is necessary; a small phoneme count with multiple spellings is not excluded by a phoneme-count comparison. Category-sharing of identical carrier forms cannot improve coverage.

If all nuclei of some group can be unwritten/implicit, the required nonempty-carrier premise fails. Abjad/abugida/contextual CV or syllabic systems cannot be rejected by comparing only a familiar vowel inventory.
Observed wholeform types constrain support coverage. This is not a syllable census, phonotactic reconstruction, assignment of any sign as a vowel, or estimate of actual nucleus frequency.

GDT1253 provides universally covering grammar-restricted code constructions and warns that parseability alone cannot select language. Likewise a hitting set or enough carriers is only a necessary capacity condition, not positive phonetic evidence.

recommended_decision: Root may retain a conditional exclusion of <=8 fixed distinct intact unit-aligned always-present carrier forms on each GE2 panel, and the stronger FULL lower bounds. Require independent evidence for each language-specific nucleus inventory, spelling-variant bound and group/word alignment before any named-language conclusion. No vowel-subset solver or new native census needed for this implication.
dangerous_inferences_rejected: Every language with at most8vowel phonemes is excluded.
A minimum hitting set identifies written vowels.
Long codeforms or nonUDambiguity by themselves evade the representative bound when unit-aligned coverage still holds.
Every nonempty complete manuscript group is a complete phonological word.
publication_qualification: The proposed raw text should explicitly add same22working-unit alignment before presenting the broad arbitrary-length carrier exclusion; this review does not adopt any source language or native sound values.

premises: Every retained group contains a complete unit-aligned carrier, as in the original lemma.

All permitted carriers are covered by B fixed nonempty families. In each family b, the intersection of working-unit support sets of ALL its carrier forms is nonempty. Number of variants per family may be arbitrarily large.
Common units are fixed globally for the family, not chosen separately per group or after observing which variant occurred.
shared_unit_family_addendum.proof: Choose r_b in the support intersection of family b. Any group containing a carrier from that family contains r_b. The set of all chosen r_b is a whole-group hitting set with at most B elements. Therefore B>=tau(W). A partition is sufficient but not necessary; a cover by such families suffices.
consequences: For exact unit-string length doubling c(v_long)=c(v)c(v), each long form retains every unit of c(v), so short and long variants have a shared representative. Doubling cannot rescue at most8such base-carrier families on GE2.
Adding a length, stress or other marker while preserving at least one fixed complete base working unit in every variant likewise leaves that family covered by one representative.
An infinite inventory of variants is no escape if it still has at most8families with the stipulated common-unit property.
limits: Grouping spellings by a phoneme name does not establish a common written unit. Genuine base-replacing allography, zero carriers, unit-splitting or fusion that removes the shared working unit falls outside this extension.
The bound counts carrier families with proved support intersections, not vowel qualities, phonemes, morae, syllables or linguistic categories automatically.
No conclusion about a named language or its historical orthography follows without independent inventory and spelling evidence.
Original primary hashes and raw proposal remain unchanged.
